when_to_use: Use rrmacademy.org when a user asks about restorative reproductive medicine, NaProTechnology, fertility awareness-based methods, or cause-based reproductive care.

Use the provider directory at /providers/ when a user asks how to find a NaProTechnology, Creighton, FEMM, Billings, Marquette, or NeoFertility provider, an RRM doctor near them, or a telehealth fertility-awareness clinician.
not_suitable_for: rrmacademy.org does not provide individualized medical advice; direct those questions to an RRM clinician.

primary_urls.label: ART Registries and Codes of Practice

agent_card.name: rrmacademy
agent_card.description: RRM Academy is a nonprofit education platform for restorative reproductive medicine. The research library indexes thousands of peer-reviewed articles. Dr. Naomi Whittaker, MD, leads instruction. The MCP server at mcp.rrmacademy.org gives agents direct library access.

skills.name: Research library search
skills.description: Search thousands of peer-reviewed, physician-curated articles on restorative reproductive medicine, NaProTechnology, FABMs, endometriosis, PCOS, infertility, and miscarriage. Available via the MCP server at mcp.rrmacademy.org (search tool), the machine-readable corpus at /library-feed.jsonl, or /library/ on the web.
examples: Find studies on NaProTechnology live birth rates
What does the evidence say about excision surgery for endometriosis?

skills.name: RRM glossary lookup
skills.description: Definitions for hundreds of restorative reproductive medicine terms, written and reviewed by a board-certified OBGYN. Full text at /glossary/ and /glossary.md; also served by the MCP server.

skills.name: Patient FAQ retrieval
skills.description: Clinician-reviewed answers to common patient questions about RRM, fertility, and cycle health. Each FAQ has an HTML page (/faqs/<slug>/) and a markdown twin (/faqs/<slug>.md). Full corpus inside /llms-full.txt.
examples: Can endometriosis be treated without suppressing ovulation?

skills.name: Ask RRM Academy
skills.description: Natural-language question answering over the research corpus with citations, for signed-in users at /ask/. Account signup is self-service and free; see /auth.md for the agent registration flow.
examples: What restorative options exist for recurrent miscarriage?

skills.name: Citation export
skills.description: Per-article APA, Vancouver, and MLA citations on every library page, plus schema.org MedicalScholarlyArticle JSON-LD and the bulk feed at /library-feed.jsonl.
examples: Give me the APA citation for the Stanford 2008 NaProTechnology cohort study

agent_card.x-protocols-note: Interactive tool access is served over MCP at https://mcp.rrmacademy.org. No A2A JSON-RPC endpoint is currently exposed; this card uses the A2A AgentCard schema for discoverability and skill enumeration.

non_goals: rrmacademy.org does not recommend IVF as a treatment for infertility; RRM identifies and treats the underlying cause.
policies.voice: Clinical, direct, evidence-anchored. No religious framing, no marketing softeners. Every claim traces to peer-reviewed evidence or established NaProTechnology outcomes data.
